class.name: VehicleAudioGuideData
class.brief_description: Physical authoring data for one bidirectional waveguide.
class.description: VehicleAudioGuideData connects two named nodes. During setup, length in metres becomes an integer delay at the configured sample rate, loss per metre becomes exponential traversal attenuation, and high-frequency loss per metre becomes a compiled one-pole coefficient applied independently to both travelling directions.

method.name: set_from
method.description: Sets the source endpoint node name.

method.name: get_from
method.description: Returns the source endpoint node name.

method.name: set_to
method.description: Sets the destination endpoint node name.

method.name: get_to
method.description: Returns the destination endpoint node name.

method.name: set_length_meters
method.description: Sets the positive physical guide length in metres.

method.name: get_length_meters
method.description: Returns the authored guide length in metres.

method.name: set_area
method.description: Sets the positive cross-sectional area used for junction weighting.

method.name: set_loss_per_meter
method.description: Sets non-negative traversal loss per metre.

method.name: get_loss_per_meter
method.description: Returns the authored traversal loss per metre.

method.name: set_high_frequency_loss_per_meter
method.description: Sets non-negative high-frequency loss per metre compiled for each guide direction.

method.name: get_high_frequency_loss_per_meter
method.description: Returns the authored high-frequency loss per metre.

members.member: Named node at one guide endpoint.
Named node at the other guide endpoint.
Positive physical length; converted to an integer delay during setup.
Positive cross-sectional area used in node scattering.
Non-negative loss coefficient; traversal attenuation is exp(-loss_per_meter * length_meters).
Non-negative HF loss coefficient; setup compiles exp(-high_frequency_loss_per_meter * length_meters) into independent per-direction one-pole filtering.
